evidence: Walked every negative leg (refused / not offered / hidden / unchanged / not seen / not listed / no line / empty / not loaded again) across all five dimensions and found a matching same-kind success inside the same criterion, or an explicit global same-kind control rule. Functional global rule, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:13: 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.'; prompt.md:17 for role replays: 'Send the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards (or before, on another card) as its control; a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal', plus fresh-version rule so a stale-version refusal cannot masquerade as a rule/role refusal. Per-criterion pairing (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open:29 invalid jobs refused / 'the successful opening is the control'; hro_add_email_rules:47 invalid+case-duplicate refused / 'same address on a different job is accepted (the control)'; hro_move_one_stage:56 skips refused / one-stage forward+back work; hro_reject_reason:83 blank refused / reasoned reject works; hro_reject_hired:92 'A rejection of a non-hired card is the control' and the card must be Hired; hro_reopen:101 elsewhere refused / own stage works; hro_interview_full:110 'the two cards that entered Interview are the control'; hro_undo_full:128 refused / 'same undo goes ahead ... (the same-kind control)'; hro_mgr_early_refused:155 'their late-stage moves are the control' (+ global Rafael same-request control); hro_mgr_other_job:164 'the job's own manager's move is the control'; hro_observer_readonly:173 'Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'; hro_candidate_no_staff:182 candidate sign-in + own data, staff control, and 'Fails if ... the staff control did not succeed'; hro_anonymous:191 'A signed-in success of each is the control'; hro_stale_refused:200 'The original successful move is the control' and must name the changer (positive content); hro_bulk_all_or_none:218 and hro_bulk_places:227 successful multi-card moves as control; hro_undo_conflict:245 unrelated-change undo goes ahead '(the same-kind control)'; hro_undo_once:254 'The successful undos are the control'; hro_activity_refusals:272 'The successful actions' lines are the control'; hro_notes:281 other-manager refused / own manager + recruiter notes succeed, Observer reads; hro_msg_compose:308 blank refused / 'A normal send is the control'; hro_thread_access:362 Ingrid/Observer/Noor refused / Rafael, Mei, Bill write, Observer reads, 'Rafael's own send is the control'; hro_candidate_private:389 own data loads '(the control)', Rafael's identical read succeeded, 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'; hro_unread_counts:335 own messages never count / others' raise by exactly two; hro_unread_scrolled_up:344 view not moved / notice appears and read after going; hro_seen:353 not seen after Observer / seen after Tomas, Bill, Rafael; hro_restart:407 seed not reloaded / own work survives. Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread make 'no change to draft/focus/scroll' conditional on the update actually arriving ('If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'); hro_pol_failed_send pairs 'nothing was sent' with resend 'sent once'; hro_pol_session_resume pairs 'Mei sees neither draft' with Rafael's drafts surviving and the resumed reply sending ('the positive control'). Render gate prompt.md:9 + judge.toml:23: wrong password leaves signed out / 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'. Constraints gate is positive-only (UI create + independent Observer readback). Visual is likert craft, no negative legs. Broken-app attempts: (a) blank/static shell fails both gates and the in-prompt global gate (prompt.md:13 'every binary criterion 0'); (b) an app whose server refuses every write passes the gates? No: constraints gate requires a UI-created job/card read back in an independent Observer context; (c) an app where moves are entirely broken: hro_move_one_stage, hro_interview_full, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_bulk_*, hro_undo_* all lose their stated controls; (d) an app with no Activity view fails hro_activity_refusals' 'successful actions' lines' control; (e) a candidate login that loads nothing scores 0 on hro_candidate_no_staff/private explicitly; (f) an app with no live updates gets 0 on the polish preservation rows instead of passing by stasis. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app that hides disallowed controls is accepted ('hiding it is optional', 'Whether ... is the app's choice') with server refusal verified by replay, so suppression-by-hiding is neither required nor penalised. Minor wording observation (not a defect, P3-level, no fix required): most refusal rows' explicit 'Fails if' sentence names only the negative and rely on the stated control plus 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold' and prompt.md:13 'needs its own positive control'; the template's stronger sentence 'If one cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence' is not carried verbatim, and hro_mgr_early_refused names only 'late-stage moves' as its control for non-move legs (reject Screen, re-order Applied, reopen, open job, add candidate), with same-kind controls supplied by the global Rafael-replay rule and protocols S/M/R. Whether the configured judge actually zeroes a refusal row when its control fails is unmeasured (raw-evidence-index scope: no configured judge or weak-app discrimination run); that is runtime evidence owned by the discrimination records, not this design row.
